decision.reasoning_trace: In this browsing session, I evaluated several backpack options. The SHENHU 40L (prod_backpacks_111) and KAILAS 28L (prod_backpacks_043) were the strongest candidates for hiking, with the latter having an impressive internal frame design. The Gelindo hydration pack (prod_backpacks_078) also showed high consumer satisfaction. However, a significant portion of the product feed was cluttered with irrelevant items like rifle rests, camping stoves, and folding chairs. Additionally, many of the actual bags were either niche (sports-themed or kids' characters) or very small (the MOSISO sling). Given that I am looking for a specific balance of durability and capacity for serious trekking, and the top-tier options here either lacked extensive long-term reviews or didn't quite hit the professional specifications I wanted, I decided to hold off on a purchase for now.
